annotations.title: Housing pipeline of one municipality: cases to completions

description: Use this when one municipality's housing pipeline from licence to completion is needed: cases, INE licences and completions, units for sale. Do not use it for monthly building activity (`construction_barometer`). Periods differ by stage; unknown is null, not 0.

language.description: Language of the page links and labels; the text summary and field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

municipality.description: Municipality name in any case, accents optional (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos; Lisbon and Oporto are accepted) or its four-digit code (1312). Close spellings are found; two matches return an `ambiguous` error with candidates

name: municipality_housing_pipeline

anyOf.description: One municipality: every stage with its own period and source.

durations.description: Age of licensing cases in progress (an age, not a processing time).

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Housing pipeline of one municipality: cases to completions
